```{r, "Functions for analysis"}
#Functions for analysis

get_singler_main <- function(seu){
    
    bped <- celldex::BlueprintEncodeData()
    
    DefaultAssay(seu) <- "SCT"
  pred_main <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu) %>%
    SingleR(ref = bped, labels = bped$label.main)
  
  
    seu$SingleR.labels <- pred_main$labels
    cat(paste0("\033[31m","\nSummarize of SingleR annotation table\n"))
    print(table(seu$SingleR.labels))
    return(seu)
    
 
  }
  
get_singler_fine <- function(seu){
    
    monaco <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()
    
    DefaultAssay(seu) <- "SCT"
  pred_fine <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu) %>%
    SingleR(ref = monaco, labels = monaco$label.fine)
    
    
    seu$SingleR_sub_labels <- pred_fine$labels
    cat(paste0("\033[31m","\nSummarize of SingleR annotation table\n"))
    # print(table(seu$SingleR_sub_labels))    
    return(seu)
    
 
  }
  
get_four_umap_basic <- function(seu,size) {
  p_clusters <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "seurat_clusters", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Seurat Clusters")
  
  p_sample <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "sample", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by sample")
  
  p_singler <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "SingleR.labels", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by SingleR Labels")
  
  p_condition <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "condition", reduction.use = "umap", size = size, opacity = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Sample")
  
  # Combine plots into one
  p_final <- ((p_clusters + p_condition) / (p_singler + p_sample))
  
  # Return the combined plot invisibly to avoid printing in the function
  invisible(p_final)
}
  

  
get_p_avg_expr_log2_same_seurat_object <- function(seu) {
  Idents(seu) <- "orig.ident"
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "SCT"

  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seu, assays = "SCT", group.by = "orig.ident")
  avg_exp <- as.data.frame(avg_exp)
  
  column_names <- colnames(avg_exp)

#Creating new, eazy to work with columns
{
  {if (!(length(column_names) == 2)) {
    stop("Error in the function 'get_p_avg_expr_log2': The number of unique original idents in the merged Seurat object isn't 2 as expected. Please change it accordingly")
} else if (any(grepl("Healthy", column_names[1]))) {
    avg_exp$SCT.patient <- avg_exp[[column_names[2]]]
    avg_exp$SCT.control <- avg_exp[[column_names[1]]]
} else if (any(grepl("Healthy", column_names[2]))) {
    avg_exp$SCT.patient <- avg_exp[[column_names[1]]]
    avg_exp$SCT.control <- avg_exp[[column_names[2]]]
}
  else {
    # If patient identifier is not found in either column name
    stop("Error in the function 'get_p_avg_expr_log2': patient_orig_ident was not found in any of the original idents. Please make sure to call the function with the correct patient_orig_ident.")
}
}

#Remove the original columns
avg_exp[[column_names[1]]] <- NULL
avg_exp[[column_names[2]]] <- NULL
  
}

  # Making sure the columns are numeric and making it ready for log
  avg_exp$SCT.control <- as.numeric(as.character(avg_exp$SCT.control))
  avg_exp$SCT.patient <- as.numeric(as.character(avg_exp$SCT.patient))

  avg_exp$SCT.control <- avg_exp$SCT.control + 1
  avg_exp$SCT.patient <- avg_exp$SCT.patient + 1

  line_data <- data.frame(x = range(avg_exp$SCT.control, avg_exp$SCT.patient, na.rm = TRUE))
  line_data$y <- line_data$x  # displaying the line y = x
  avg_exp <- avg_exp %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")

gene_to_be_displayed <- avg_exp %>%
    filter(SCT.patient >= 1.5,
           SCT.patient >= SCT.control,
           SCT.patient > 2,
           SCT.control > 2) %>% pull(gene)
  
  
weird_genes <- avg_exp %>%
    filter(SCT.patient >= SCT.control,
          SCT.control <1.1,
          SCT.patient > 1.35
           ) %>% pull(gene)


housekeeping_genes <- c("B2M", "H3F3A", "MALAT1", "YBX1", "UBA52", 
                        "PSMB9", "ATP5E", "ATP5L", "UQCR11", "TOMM7")
    
# Filter genes for labeling

label_genes <- avg_exp %>%
    filter(gene %in% gene_to_be_displayed,
            !(gene %in% housekeeping_genes),
           !grepl("^MT", gene),
           !grepl("^RP", gene),
          (SCT.patient - SCT.control) >= 0.5)

  mt_genes <- (length(grep("^MT", gene_to_be_displayed)) / length(gene_to_be_displayed)) * 100
  ribo_genes <- (length(grep("^RP", gene_to_be_displayed)) / length(gene_to_be_displayed)) * 100

condition_name <- sub("-Mevorach$", "", unique(seu@meta.data$orig.ident))

plot_title <- paste0("Healthy Control (from ",unique(seu@meta.data$orig.ident),") vs ",condition_name," Patient Averaged Expression Levels")


p_avg_mon <- ggplot(avg_exp, aes(x = SCT.control, y = SCT.patient)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = ifelse(gene %in% gene_to_be_displayed, "significant", "non-significant"))) +
    geom_line(data = line_data, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "blue") +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = scales::log2_trans()) +  # Log2 scale for x-axis
    scale_y_continuous(trans = scales::log2_trans()) +  # Log2 scale for y-axis
    scale_color_manual(values = c("significant" = "red", "non-significant" = "black")) +
    labs(x = "Log2(Control)", y = "Log2(Patient)",
         title = plot_title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +  # Remove legend title
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Percent of ribo_genes: %.2f%%", ribo_genes), 
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 2.1, size = 5, color = "blue") +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Percent of mt_genes: %.2f%%", mt_genes), 
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 4.1, size = 5, color = "blue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_genes, aes(x = SCT.control, y = SCT.patient, label = gene),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf)  # Adding gene labels without overlap

  
print(p_avg_mon)
  
output_list <- list()
output_list$plot <- p_avg_mon
output_list$de_genes <- gene_to_be_displayed
output_list$artificat <- weird_genes
output_list$plot_title <- plot_title

  # Return the plot invisibly to avoid printing
  return(output_list)
}


    
convert_to_msigdbr_format <- function(pathway_name,db) {
  paste0(db,"_", gsub(" ", "_", toupper(pathway_name)))
}


get_volcano <- function(de_results, key_genes, plottitle, group_a, group_b) {
  

  
  # Load necessary libraries and source the custom theme
  {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(gridExtra))
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggrepel))
    source('/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/ggplot_theme_Publication-2.R')
  } 
  
  # Calculate the maximum absolute value on the x-axis to determine symmetric limits
  max_x_value <- max(abs(de_results$avg_log2FC))
  
  # Create the color mapping dynamically
  color_values <- c(
    group_a = "#00B0BA",
    group_b = "#f87f01",
    "Other" = "#cccccc"
  )
  names(color_values)[1] <- group_a
  names(color_values)[2] <- group_b
  
  #Adjusting de_results columns
  de_results$y_display <- -log10(de_results$p_val_adj)
  de_results <-  de_results %>%
  mutate(color_group = case_when(
    (pct.1 > 0.5 & pct.1 - pct.2 > 0.15) ~ "Patient-Dominant",
    (pct.2 > 0.5 & pct.2 - pct.1 > 0.15) ~ "Control-Dominant",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))


de_results$gene <- rownames(de_results)

  
  # Create the volcano plot
  p_mon <- ggplot(de_results, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = y_display, color = color_group)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_text_repel(data = de_results %>% filter(gene %in% key_genes),
                    aes(label = gene, color = color_group),  
                    point.padding = 5,  #  point padding
                    nudge_y = 0.5,  # Slightly nudge the text labels up
                    max.overlaps = Inf,  # Allow infinite overlaps for key genes
                    size = 4  # Set a fixed size for all gene labels
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-max_x_value - 1, max_x_value + 1)) +  # Expanding x-axis limits
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.2))) +  # Expanding y-axis on both ends
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1.30, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -1, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", size = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", size = 1) +
    labs(title = plottitle,
         x = "Log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
         size = "Percentage in Group 1",
         color = "Gene Group") +
    guides(size = guide_legend(title = "Percentage in Patient cells")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_values,
                       breaks = c(group_a, group_b, "Other")) +
    theme_dark_blue() +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = "The points were capped at 280 for display",
             hjust = 0, vjust = -1, color = "white", size = 3.5)
  
  return(p_mon)
}



get_four_umaps_pathway <- function (pathway_name, de_results ,seu, threshold,db,gene){
  pathway_name
  de_results$gene <- rownames(de_results)
  
  full_db <- paste0("CP:",db)
specific_pathway  <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = full_db) %>% filter(gs_name == convert_to_msigdbr_format(pathway_name,db))
  
key_genes <- list(
  key_genes = de_results %>%
    filter(gene %in% specific_pathway$human_gene_symbol) %>%
    # filter(abs(avg_log2FC) > threshold) %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    unique())
  
seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = key_genes, name = NULL)      
pathway_name <- paste(pathway_name,"Pathway Key Genes Expression (Excluding",gene,")")

#And finally, print it
p_key_genes <- FeaturePlot_scCustom(seurat_object = seu, features = "key_genes")  + ggtitle(pathway_name) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 12))

#Creating the other regular 3 umaps and printing them all togther
{
    p_clusters <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "seurat_clusters", reduction.use = "umap") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Seurat Clusters")
  
    p_gene <- dittoDimPlot(seu, paste0(gene,"_status"), reduction.use = "umap", opacity = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = paste("UMAP by Sample",gene, "Expression"))
    
    p_phase <- dittoDimPlot(seu,"Phase", reduction.use = "umap", color.panel = brewer.pal(6, "Paired")) +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Phase")
  
  
  }

p_umap_key_genes <- ((p_gene | p_key_genes) / (p_phase | p_clusters)) 
  #Boxplot
{
  
boxplot <- dittoBoxPlot(object = seu, var = "key_genes", group.by = paste0(gene,"_status"), main = pathway_name)

  
}

  return(  list(p_umap_key_genes = p_umap_key_genes, key_genes = key_genes, boxplot = boxplot))
  
  

}


get_four_umaps_subclustring <- function(seu) {
    
      p_clusters <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "seurat_clusters", reduction.use = "umap") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Seurat Clusters")
  
    p_condition <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "condition", reduction.use = "umap", opacity = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Sample")
    
p_subcluster <- dittoDimPlot(seu,"SingleR_sub_labels", reduction.use = "umap", color.panel = brewer.pal(9, "Set1")) +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by SingleR sub cluster")
  
p_phase <- dittoDimPlot(seu,"Phase", reduction.use = "umap", ) +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Celly Cycle")

p_4_umaps_sub_clustring <- ((p_clusters | p_condition) / (p_subcluster | p_phase)) 
  
return(p_4_umaps_sub_clustring)
}

get_scpa <- function(seu, fgroup1, fgroup1_population, gene = NULL){
    #kegg
  {
    
      pathways_kegg <- msigdbr("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:KEGG") %>%
    format_pathways()
  
  results_kegg <- compare_seurat(seu,
                               assay = "SCT",
                               group1 = fgroup1, 
                               group1_population = fgroup1_population,
                               pathways = pathways_kegg,
                               parallel = TRUE,
                               cores = 4)   %>%
    mutate(Pathway = gsub("^KEGG_", "", Pathway),    # remove "KEGG_MEDICUS" 
           Pathway = tolower(Pathway),               # convert to lower case
           Pathway = gsub("_", " ", Pathway),        # replace "_" with ""
           Pathway = str_to_title(Pathway))          # Convert to title case
  

    
  results_kegg <- results_kegg %>%
    filter(FC > -0.3) %>%
    arrange(desc(qval)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
  if (!is.null(gene)) {
  title <- paste("Pathway Analysis by KEGG Without", gene)
} else {
  title <- "Pathway Analysis by KEGG"
}
  
    p_pathways_kegg <- ggdotchart(results_kegg, x = "Pathway", y = "FC",  title = title,
                               color = "adjPval",
                               sorting = "descending",
                               add = "segments",
                               rotate = TRUE,
                               dot.size = 10,
                               gradient.cols = c("darkgreen", "grey"),
                               font.label = list(color = "white", size = 9, vjust = 0.5),              
                               ggtheme = theme_pubr(),
                               ylab = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))
    
  }
  
  #reactom
  {
        pathways_reactom <- msigdbr("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:REACTOME") %>%
    format_pathways()
  
  results_reactom <- compare_seurat(seu,
                               assay = "SCT",
                               group1 = fgroup1, 
                               group1_population = fgroup1_population,
                               pathways = pathways_reactom,
                               parallel = TRUE,
                               cores = 4)   %>%
    mutate(Pathway = gsub("^REACTOME_", "", Pathway),    # remove "REACTOME_" 
           Pathway = tolower(Pathway),               # convert to lower case
           Pathway = gsub("_", " ", Pathway),        # replace "_" with ""
           Pathway = str_to_title(Pathway))          # convert to title case
  
  
  
  
  results_reactom <- results_reactom %>%
    filter(FC > -0.3) %>%
    arrange(desc(qval)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
  
  if (!is.null(gene)) {
  title <- paste("Pathway Analysis by REACTOME Without", gene)
} else {
  title <- "Pathway Analysis by REACTOME"
}  
    p_pathways_reactom <- ggdotchart(results_reactom, x = "Pathway", y = "FC", title = title,
                               color = "adjPval",
                               sorting = "descending",
                               add = "segments",
                               rotate = TRUE,
                               dot.size = 10,
                               gradient.cols = c("darkblue", "grey"),
                               font.label = list(color = "white", size = 9, vjust = 0.5),              
                               ggtheme = theme_pubr(),
                               ylab = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))
  }


  print("These are the kegg results:")
  print(results_kegg)
  print("These are the reactom results:")
  print(results_reactom)

    # Return a list with the two plots
  result_list <- list(p_pathways_kegg = p_pathways_kegg,
                      p_pathways_reactom = p_pathways_reactom,
                      results_kegg = results_kegg,
                      results_reactom = results_reactom)
  
  return(result_list)
  
  
}

  

  

get_nk_subtype <- function(seu) {
  
  library(BiocParallel)
  rucket_reference <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/data_for_get_nk_subtype/seu_rueckert_refrence.qs")
  
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"
      
  # SingleR
  pred_fine <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu) %>%
    SingleR(ref = rucket_reference, 
            labels = rucket_reference$type, 
            assay.type.ref = "counts", 
            assay.type.test = "counts",
            de.method = "wilcox", 
            BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(100))
  
  # Fine tuning + updating Seurat
  {
      adaptive_indices <- which(pred_fine$labels == "Adaptive" & pred_fine$delta.next < 0.11)
  
  # Reassign these cells to "Dim"
  pred_fine$labels[adaptive_indices] <- "Dim"
  
  # If you've already stored these labels in your Seurat object:
  seu$SingleR_NK_sub_labels <- pred_fine$labels
    }

  
  print(plotDeltaDistribution(pred_fine, show = "delta.next"))
  print(plotScoreHeatmap(pred_fine))

    
  table(seu$SingleR_NK_sub_labels)
    
  color_palette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#CC79A7")
  print(dittoDimPlot(seu, var = "SingleR_NK_sub_labels", color.panel = color_palette))
  
  # My_dotplot

  my_dotplot <- DotPlot(seu,

                       "KLRC2", "CD3E", "PATL2", "ZBTB38"),

                       "FCER1G", "NCR1", "IFNG"),

}


get_percentage_barplot <- function(seu, groupby, data_name){
  
  title =paste("Distribution of NK cells subtypes across conditions in the",data_name,"data")
  color_palette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73",  "#CC79A7")

  
  # Create the dittoBarPlot and extract the plot and data
plot_data <- dittoBarPlot(seu, "SingleR_NK_sub_labels", group.by = groupby, main = title,  color.panel = color_palette)

data <- plot_data$data %>%
  group_by(grouping) %>%
  arrange(label) %>%
  mutate(mid_y = case_when(
    row_number() == 1 ~ 1 - (percent / 2),
    row_number() == 2 ~ (1 - lag(percent)) - (percent / 2),
    row_number() == 3 ~ (1 - lag(percent, 2) - lag(percent, 1)) - (percent / 2),
    row_number() == 4 ~ (1 - lag(percent, 3) - lag(percent, 2)- lag(percent, 1)) - (percent / 2)    
  ))


# cumsum(percent) - 0.5 * percent
plot_data <- plot_data + geom_text(data = data, aes(x = grouping, y = mid_y, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent * 100)), color = "white", size = 6, fontface = "bold")

return (plot_data)
  
}



get_update_nk_prcnt <- function(nk_prcnt,seu, sample, data) {
  
  
# Column existence checks
if (!(sample %in% unique(colnames(seu@meta.data)))) {
  print(paste("Column", sample, "does not exist in the data frame."))
  break
} else if (!("condition" %in% unique(colnames(seu@meta.data)))) {
  print("Column condition does not exist in the data frame.")
  break
} else {
  # Get unique conditions
  unique_samples <- unique(seu@meta.data[[sample]])
  seu$temp <- seu@meta.data[[sample]]

i=0
  for (current_sample in unique_samples) {
    # Filter seu_mevorach for the current condition
    condition_data <- subset(seu, temp == current_sample)

    # Get dataset and disease (which is the same as condition in this case)
    dataset <- unique(condition_data$orig.ident)
    disease <- unique(condition_data$condition)
    
    # Get the percentages from the 'data' table
    dim_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Dim" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)
    bright_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Bright" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)
    adaptive_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Adaptive" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)
    proliferating_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Proliferating" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)  
    
    # If no data is found, set percentages to 0
    if (length(dim_prcnt) == 0) dim_prcnt <- 0
    if (length(bright_prcnt) == 0) bright_prcnt <- 0
    if (length(adaptive_prcnt) == 0) adaptive_prcnt <- 0
    if (length(proliferating_prcnt) == 0) proliferating_prcnt <- 0
    
    # Create a new row
    new_row <- data.frame(
      sample = current_sample,
      dataset = dataset,
      disease = disease,
      dim_prcnt = dim_prcnt,
      bright_prcnt = bright_prcnt,
      adaptive_prcnt = adaptive_prcnt,
      proliferating_prcnt = proliferating_prcnt,  # Corrected spelling
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Append the new row to nk_prcnt
    nk_prcnt <- rbind(nk_prcnt, new_row)
    i=i+1
  }
      print(paste("nk_prcnt get updated",i,"times")) 

    return (nk_prcnt)

}
  


}

get_confusion_matrix <- function(seu_cd59, seu_cd55, method_column) {
  
#Checking that the method_column indeed exsists in each of the seurat objects
    if (!(method_column %in% unique(colnames(seu_cd59@meta.data)))) {
      print(paste("Column", method_column, "does not exist in the seu_cd59 data."))
      break }
      else if (!(method_column %in% unique(colnames(seu_cd55@meta.data)))) {
      print(paste("Column", method_column, "does not exist in the seu_cd55 data."))
      break } 
      
      
 else {
   
    # Create a temp column that will hold the method_column variables
    seu_cd59$temp <- seu_cd59@meta.data[[method_column]]
    seu_cd55$temp <- seu_cd55@meta.data[[method_column]]
    
    # Calculate True Positives (TP), False Positives (FP), False Negatives (FN), True Negatives (TN)
    tp <- sum(seu_cd59$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart == "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart == "NK cells")
    
    fp <- sum(seu_cd59$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart != "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart != "NK cells")
    
    fn <- sum(seu_cd59$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart == "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart == "NK cells")
    
    tn <- sum(seu_cd59$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart != "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart != "NK cells")
    
    precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
    sensitivity <- tp / (tp + fn)
    f1_score <- 2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity)
    accuracy <- (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn)
    
    # Create a matrix for the confusion matrix
    confusion_matrix <- matrix(c(tp, fn, fp, tn), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                               dimnames = list(
                                 "Actual" = c("Actual Positive", "Actual Negative"),
                                 "Predicted" = c("Predicted Positive", "Predicted Negative")
                               ))
    
    # Create a data frame for the metrics
    metrics <- data.frame(
      Metric = c("Sensitivity", "Precision", "F1 Score", "Accuracy"),
      Value = c(sensitivity, precision, f1_score, accuracy)
    )
    
    # Combine the confusion matrix and metrics into a list
    output <- list(
      ConfusionMatrix = confusion_matrix,
      Metrics = metrics
    )
    
    # Return the output
    return(output)
      }

}

  get_nk <- function(seu){
  


  seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 80)
  
  #SingleR with Blueprint
  {
     singler_ref <- celldex::BlueprintEncodeData()


singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                           ref = singler_ref,
                           labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main,
                           clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
)

x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)

seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80")

  }

  #SingleR with Monaco
  
  {
      singler_ref <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()


singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                           ref = singler_ref,
                           labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main,
                           clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80

)

x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)

seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80")
  }

  #Ucell with Viver's NK Signature
  
  {
      positive_nk_signature <- c("CD160+", "CD244+", "CHST12+", "CST7+", "GNLY+", "IL18RAP+", "IL2RB+", "KLRC1+", "KLRC3+", "KLRD1+", "KLRF1+", "PRF1+", "XCL2+")


signatures <- list(
  positive_nk_signature = positive_nk_signature)

seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)

seu$nk_by_ucell <- ifelse(seu$positive_nk_signature >= 0.4, "NK cells", "other")

  }

# Final idetification
  
seu$is_nk <- dplyr::case_when(
  (seu$nk_by_ucell == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "NK cells") |
  (seu$nk_by_ucell == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "NK cells") |
  (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "NK cells") ~ "NK cells",
  TRUE ~ "other"
)

    return(seu)
  }

{
  
required_columns <- c("SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80", 
                      "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80",

# Initialize a list to collect missing column information
missing_info <- list()

# Iterate through the list of Seurat objects
for (seu_name in names(list_seu)) {
  # Get the Seurat object
  seu <- list_seu[[seu_name]]
  
  # Check for missing columns in the Seurat object's metadata
  missing_columns <- required_columns[!(required_columns %in% colnames(seu@meta.data))]
  
  # If any columns are missing, add this information to the missing_info list
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    missing_info[[seu_name]] <- missing_columns
  }
}

# After checking all Seurat objects, decide whether to continue or break
if (length(missing_info) > 0) {
  # If there are any missing columns, print the details and break
  for (seu_name in names(missing_info)) {
    print(paste("The following columns are missing in", seu_name, "data:", 
                paste(missing_info[[seu_name]], collapse = ", ")))
  }
  break
} else {

}
}

return (plot_list)
  }

  filter_housekeeping_genes <- function(original_table) {


#Filter out housekeeping, ribosomal, mitochondrial and hemoglobin genes

  #Read housekeeping genes names

joshi_hk_genes <- read_excel("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/joshi_low_gini_coefficients_genes.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)

  levanon_hk_genes <- read_excel("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/levanon_housekeeping_genes.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
  
 final_table <- original_table 
  # Add a temporary column with rownames
final_table$temp_rownames <- rownames(final_table)

# Combine all housekeeping genes from both files into a single vector
all_hk_genes <- c(joshi_hk_genes[[2]], levanon_hk_genes[[1]])

# Store the initial number of rows in final_table
initial_row_count <- nrow(final_table)

# Filter out rows whose names are in the housekeeping genes
final_table <- final_table[!final_table$temp_rownames %in% all_hk_genes, ]



# Calculate and print the number of rows removed
rows_removed <- initial_row_count - nrow(final_table)
print(paste("Number of housekeeping genes removed:", rows_removed))

initial_row_count <- nrow(final_table)


final_table <- final_table[!grepl("^MT-|^RP[SL]|^HB[^(P|E|S)]|^AC[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$|^AL[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", final_table$temp_rownames), ]


final_table$temp_rownames <- NULL

rows_removed <- initial_row_count - nrow(final_table)
print(paste("Number of additonal ribosomal, mitochondrial and hemoglobin genes and some lncRNAs removed:", rows_removed))

return (final_table)  
}


}
```

```{r, "get_edgeR_ZW",eval=FALSE}

patient_list_copy <- patient_list
patient_list <- patient_list$seu_esaulova_ms_1
threshold <- 0.75
get_edgeR_ZW <- function(patient_list, healthy_list, threshold) {
  
    seu_patient <- patient_list$seu
    seu_patient$sample <- patient_list$sample
    
  # Aggregate patient counts using the "counts" slot and grouping by "sample"
  seu_patient_count <- AggregateExpression(
    seu_patient, 
    assays = "RNA", 
    slot = "counts", 
    return.seurat = FALSE, 
    group.by = "sample"
  )
  
  # Rename the patient's aggregated column
  colnames(seu_patient_count$RNA) <- paste0(
    unique(seu_patient$orig.ident), "_",
    unique(seu_patient$sample), "_",
    unique(seu_patient$condition)
  )
  
  patient_mat <- as.matrix(seu_patient_count$RNA)
  
  # Process each healthy object
  healthy_counts_list <- lapply(healthy_list, function(x) {
    seu_obj <- x$seu
    seu_obj$sample <- x$sample
    agg <- AggregateExpression(
      seu_obj, 
      assays = "RNA", 
      slot = "counts", 
      return.seurat = FALSE, 
      group.by = "sample"
    )
    colnames(agg$RNA) <- paste0(
      unique(seu_obj$orig.ident), "_",
      unique(seu_obj$sample), "_",
      unique(seu_obj$condition)
    )
    return(agg)
  })
  
  # Imputation block
  {
    ## 1. Healthy matrices: already defined as:
    healthy_mats <- lapply(healthy_counts_list, function(x) as.matrix(x$RNA))
    
    ## 2. Use patient genes as base
    patient_genes <- rownames(patient_mat)
    num_healthy <- length(healthy_mats)
    
    ## 3. For each gene in the patient, count in how many healthy matrices it is present.
    gene_presence_in_healthy <- sapply(patient_genes, function(gene) {
      sum(sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) gene %in% rownames(mat)))
    })
    gene_presence_percent <- gene_presence_in_healthy / num_healthy
    
    ## 4. Retain only the genes that are in the patient and appear in at least 'threshold' of the healthy samples.
    genes_to_keep <- patient_genes[gene_presence_percent >= threshold]
    
    # Store the names of genes in genes_to_keep that don't appear in all the controls 
    genes_for_median <- genes_to_keep[ gene_presence_in_healthy[genes_to_keep] < num_healthy ]
    
    ## 5. For each gene in genes_for_median, compute the median expression among healthy samples where it is measured.
    median_expr <- sapply(genes_for_median, function(gene) {
      values <- sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
        if (gene %in% rownames(mat)) {
          return(mat[gene, 1])  # assuming each healthy matrix is one column
        } else {
          return(NA)
        }
      })
      median(values, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
    
    ## 6. For the patient matrix, restrict to genes_to_keep.
    patient_mat_full <- patient_mat[genes_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    
    ## 7. Helper function: reformat a matrix to include exactly the genes in 'genes',
    ##    filling in missing rows with the provided median (from median_expr).
    reformat_matrix <- function(mat, genes, medians) {
      new_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(genes), ncol = ncol(mat))
      rownames(new_mat) <- genes
      colnames(new_mat) <- colnames(mat)
      common_genes <- intersect(rownames(mat), genes)
      new_mat[common_genes, ] <- mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
      missing_genes <- setdiff(genes, common_genes)
      if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
        new_mat[missing_genes, ] <- matrix(medians[missing_genes],
                                            nrow = length(missing_genes),
                                            ncol = ncol(mat),
                                            byrow = FALSE)
      }
      return(new_mat)
    }
    
    ## 8. Reformat each healthy matrix using the helper function.
    healthy_mats_full <- lapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
      reformat_matrix(mat, genes_to_keep, median_expr)
    })
    
    ## 9. Combine healthy matrices (columns) and then combine with the patient matrix.
    combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, healthy_mats_full)
    combined_counts <- cbind(patient_mat_full, combined_counts)
  }
  
  # Create Group Factor 
  group <- factor(c(rep("Patient", ncol(patient_mat_full)),
                    rep("Healthy", length(healthy_mats_full))))
  
  # Create Batch Factor 
  patient_batch <- rep(paste0(" ", unique(seu_patient$orig.ident)), ncol(patient_mat_full))
  healthy_batch <- sapply(healthy_list, function(x) paste0(names(x$RNA), " ", x$dataset))
  batch <- factor(c(patient_batch, healthy_batch))
  
    
  
  # Design Matrix, accounting for batch effect
  if (unique(seu_patient$orig.ident) %in% trimws(healthy_batch)) {
    design <- model.matrix(~ batch + group)
  } else {
    design <- model.matrix(~ group)
  }
  
  colnames(design)[colnames(design) == "groupPatient"] <- "group Patient"
  
  browser()
  # Create a DGEList Object 
  dge <- DGEList(counts = combined_counts, group = group)
  
  # Filter Lowly Expressed Genes 
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge, design = design)
  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  
  # Normalize Library Sizes 
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  
  ### ZINB-WaVE weighting step: apply ZINB-WaVE to the raw counts 
  # (Make sure to load the zinbwave and BiocParallel packages)
  
  # browser()
  
  se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = round(dge$counts)))


zinb <- zinbwave(se, K = 2, X = design, epsilon = 1000, observationalWeights = TRUE, BPPARAM = DoparParam())

  dge$weights <- assay(zinb, "weights")
  
  # Estimate Dispersions Using the GLM Approach 
  dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
  
  # Fit the GLM Quasi-likelihood Model 
  fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design)
  qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "group Patient")
  results <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)
}
```

```{r, "get_limmatrend",eval=FALSE}
      seu_obj, 
      assays = "RNA", 
      slot = "counts", 
      return.seurat = FALSE, 
      group.by = "sample"
    )
    colnames(agg$RNA) <- paste0(
      unique(seu_obj$orig.ident), "_",
      unique(seu_obj$sample), "_",
      unique(seu_obj$condition)
    )
    return(agg)
  })
  
  #### 3. Imputation block ####
  {
    # Get Healthy Matrices
    healthy_mats <- lapply(healthy_counts_list, function(x) as.matrix(x$RNA))
    
    # Use patient genes as base
    patient_genes <- rownames(patient_mat)
    num_healthy <- length(healthy_mats)
    
    # Count in how many healthy matrices each patient gene is present
    gene_presence_in_healthy <- sapply(patient_genes, function(gene) {
      sum(sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) gene %in% rownames(mat)))
    })
    gene_presence_percent <- gene_presence_in_healthy / num_healthy
    
    # Retain only genes that are in patient and appear in at least the threshold fraction of healthy samples
    genes_to_keep <- patient_genes[gene_presence_percent >= threshold]
    
    # Store names of genes in genes_to_keep that are NOT present in all healthy samples
    genes_for_median <- genes_to_keep[ gene_presence_in_healthy[genes_to_keep] < num_healthy ]
    
    # For each gene in genes_for_median, compute the median expression among healthy samples where measured
    median_expr <- sapply(genes_for_median, function(gene) {
      values <- sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
        if (gene %in% rownames(mat)) {
          return(mat[gene, 1])  # assuming one column per healthy matrix
        } else {
          return(NA)
        }
      })
      median(values, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
    
    # Restrict patient matrix to genes_to_keep
    patient_mat_full <- patient_mat[genes_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Helper function: reformat a matrix to include exactly the genes in 'genes',
    # filling missing rows with the provided median (from median_expr)
    reformat_matrix <- function(mat, genes, medians) {
      new_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(genes), ncol = ncol(mat))
      rownames(new_mat) <- genes
      colnames(new_mat) <- colnames(mat)
      common_genes <- intersect(rownames(mat), genes)
      new_mat[common_genes, ] <- mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
      missing_genes <- setdiff(genes, common_genes)
      if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
        new_mat[missing_genes, ] <- matrix(medians[missing_genes],
                                            nrow = length(missing_genes),
                                            ncol = ncol(mat),
                                            byrow = FALSE)
      }
      return(new_mat)
    }
    
    # Reformat each healthy matrix using the helper function
    healthy_mats_full <- lapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
      reformat_matrix(mat, genes_to_keep, median_expr)
    })
    
    # Combine healthy matrices (columns) and then combine with patient matrix
    combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, healthy_mats_full)
    combined_counts <- cbind(patient_mat_full, combined_counts)
  }
  
  #### 4. Create group and batch factors; build design matrix ####
  group <- factor(c(rep("Patient", ncol(patient_mat_full)),
                    rep("Healthy", length(healthy_mats_full))))
  # For the patient sample:
  patient_batch <- rep(paste0(" ", unique(seu_patient$orig.ident)), ncol(patient_mat_full))
  # Healthy batch: using x$dataset as provided
  healthy_batch <- sapply(healthy_list, function(x) paste0(names(x$RNA), " ", x$dataset))
  batch <- factor(c(patient_batch, healthy_batch))
  
  if (unique(seu_patient$orig.ident) %in% trimws(healthy_batch)) {
    design <- model.matrix(~ batch + group)
  } else {
    design <- model.matrix(~ group)
  }
  colnames(design)[colnames(design) == "groupPatient"] <- "group Patient"



  #### 5. Create a DGEList, filter and normalize ####
  dge <- DGEList(counts = combined_counts, group = group)
  keep <- filterByExpr(dge, design = design)
  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  
  
# (1) Convert counts to log2CPM with precision weights
v <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)

# (2) Fit a linear model, including your batch+group design
fit <- lmFit(v, design)

# (3) Use eBayes with trend=TRUE ("limmatrend")
fit <- eBayes(fit, trend = TRUE)

# (4) Extract top DE genes
results <- topTable(fit, coef = "group Patient", number = Inf)

return(results)

  
}
```

```{r, "get_DESeq2_ZW",eval=FALSE}
get_DESeq2_ZW <- function(seu_patient, healthy_list, threshold) {
  
    seu_patient <- patient_list$seu
    seu_patient$sample <- patient_list$sample

  # Aggregate patient counts using the "counts" slot and grouping by "sample"
  seu_patient_count <- AggregateExpression(
    seu_patient, 
    assays = "RNA", 
    slot = "counts", 
    return.seurat = FALSE, 
    group.by = "sample"
  )
  
  # Rename the patient's aggregated column
  colnames(seu_patient_count$RNA) <- paste0(
    unique(seu_patient$orig.ident), "_",
    unique(seu_patient$sample), "_",
    unique(seu_patient$condition)
  )
  
  patient_mat <- as.matrix(seu_patient_count$RNA)
  
  # Process each healthy object
  healthy_counts_list <- lapply(healthy_list, function(x) {
    seu_obj <- x$seu
    seu_obj$sample <- x$sample
    agg <- AggregateExpression(
      seu_obj, 
      assays = "RNA", 
      slot = "counts", 
      return.seurat = FALSE, 
      group.by = "sample"
    )
    colnames(agg$RNA) <- paste0(
      unique(seu_obj$orig.ident), "_",
      unique(seu_obj$sample), "_",
      unique(seu_obj$condition)
    )
    return(agg)
  })
  
  # Imputation block
  {
    ## 1. Healthy matrices: already defined as:
    healthy_mats <- lapply(healthy_counts_list, function(x) as.matrix(x$RNA))
    
    ## 2. Use patient genes as base
    patient_genes <- rownames(patient_mat)
    num_healthy <- length(healthy_mats)
    
    ## 3. For each gene in the patient, count in how many healthy matrices it is present.
    gene_presence_in_healthy <- sapply(patient_genes, function(gene) {
      sum(sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) gene %in% rownames(mat)))
    })
    gene_presence_percent <- gene_presence_in_healthy / num_healthy
    
    ## 4. Retain only the genes that are in the patient and appear in at least 'threshold' of the healthy samples.
    genes_to_keep <- patient_genes[gene_presence_percent >= threshold]
    
    # Store the names of genes in genes_to_keep that don't appear in all the controls 
    genes_for_median <- genes_to_keep[ gene_presence_in_healthy[genes_to_keep] < num_healthy ]
    
    ## 5. For each gene in genes_for_median, compute the median expression among healthy samples where it is measured.
    median_expr <- sapply(genes_for_median, function(gene) {
      values <- sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
        if (gene %in% rownames(mat)) {
          return(mat[gene, 1])  # assuming each healthy matrix is one column
        } else {
          return(NA)
        }
      })
      median(values, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
    
    ## 6. For the patient matrix, restrict to genes_to_keep.
    patient_mat_full <- patient_mat[genes_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    
    ## 7. Helper function: reformat a matrix to include exactly the genes in 'genes',
    ##    filling in missing rows with the provided median (from median_expr).
    reformat_matrix <- function(mat, genes, medians) {
      new_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(genes), ncol = ncol(mat))
      rownames(new_mat) <- genes
      colnames(new_mat) <- colnames(mat)
      common_genes <- intersect(rownames(mat), genes)
      new_mat[common_genes, ] <- mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
      missing_genes <- setdiff(genes, common_genes)
      if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
        new_mat[missing_genes, ] <- matrix(medians[missing_genes],
                                            nrow = length(missing_genes),
                                            ncol = ncol(mat),
                                            byrow = FALSE)
      }
      return(new_mat)
    }
    
    ## 8. Reformat each healthy matrix using the helper function.
    healthy_mats_full <- lapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
      reformat_matrix(mat, genes_to_keep, median_expr)
    })
    
    ## 9. Combine healthy matrices (columns) and then combine with the patient matrix.
    combined_counts <- do.call(cbind, healthy_mats_full)
    combined_counts <- cbind(patient_mat_full, combined_counts)
  }
  
  # Create Group Factor 
  group <- factor(c(rep("Patient", ncol(patient_mat_full)),
                    rep("Healthy", length(healthy_mats_full))))
  
  # Create Batch Factor 
  patient_batch <- rep(paste0(" ", unique(seu_patient$orig.ident)), ncol(patient_mat_full))
  healthy_batch <- sapply(healthy_list, function(x) paste0(names(x$RNA), " ", x$dataset))
  batch <- factor(c(patient_batch, healthy_batch))
  
    #### 6. ZINB-WaVE Weighting ####
  # Create a SummarizedExperiment for zinbwave using the rounded counts.
  
    se_zinb <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = round(combined_counts)))
  
  se_zinb <- se_zinb[rowSums(assay(se_zinb)) > 0, ]


  
    
  
# For the case where batch is used:
if (unique(seu_patient$orig.ident) %in% trimws(healthy_batch)) {
  design <- model.matrix(~ batch + group)
  colData_df <- data.frame(group = group, batch = batch)
  rownames(colData_df) <- colnames(combined_counts)
    zinb <- zinbwave(se_zinb, K = 2, X = design, epsilon = 1000, 
                    observationalWeights = TRUE, BPPARAM = SerialParam())
  # Convert the plain data.frame to a DataFrame object
  colData(zinb) <- DataFrame(colData_df)
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSet(zinb, design = ~ batch + group)
  
} else {

  design <- model.matrix(~ group)
  colData_df <- data.frame(group = group)
  rownames(colData_df) <- colnames(combined_counts)
    zinb <- zinbwave(se_zinb, K = 2, X = design, epsilon = 1000, 
                    observationalWeights = TRUE, BPPARAM = SerialParam())
  # Convert the plain data.frame to a DataFrame object
  colData(zinb) <- DataFrame(colData_df)
  
  dds <- DESeqDataSet(zinb, design = ~ group)
}

  dds <- DESeq(
  dds,
  test   = "Wald",
  fitType= "parametric",
  sfType = "ratio",
  betaPrior = FALSE,
  minReplicatesForReplace = 7,
  modelMatrixType = "standard"
)
  
res_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, coef = "group_Patient_vs_Healthy", type = "apeglm")

return(res_shrunk)

 
  }
```

```{r, "get_MAST",eval=FALSE}

seu_patient <- patient_list$seu_esaulova_ms_1$seu
threshold <- 0.75

get_MAST <- function(seu_patient, healthy_list, threshold) {

  
  #### 1. Extract SCT-normalized data from patient and healthy Seurat objects ####
  # For the patient, extract the SCT assay data as a matrix.
  patient_mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seu_patient, assay = "SCT", slot = "data"))
  
  colnames(patient_mat) <- paste0( gsub("-", "_", unique(seu_patient$orig.ident)), "-", gsub("-", "_", unique(seu_patient$sample)), "-", colnames(patient_mat))

  
  # For healthy samples, extract the SCT assay data from each healthy Seurat object.
healthy_mats <- lapply(healthy_list, function(x) {
  # Extract the SCT data as a matrix.
  mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(x$seu, assay = "SCT", slot = "data"))
  colnames(mat) <- paste0( gsub("-", "_", x$dataset), "-", gsub("-", "_", x$sample), "-",colnames(mat))
  return(mat)
})

   
  #### 2. Imputation block ####
  {
    # Use patient genes as base
    patient_genes <- rownames(patient_mat)
    num_healthy <- length(healthy_mats)
    
    # Count in how many healthy matrices each patient gene is present
    gene_presence_in_healthy <- sapply(patient_genes, function(gene) {
      sum(sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) gene %in% rownames(mat)))
    })
    gene_presence_percent <- gene_presence_in_healthy / num_healthy
    
    # Retain only genes that are in patient and appear in at least the threshold fraction of healthy samples
    genes_to_keep <- patient_genes[gene_presence_percent >= threshold]
    
    # Identify genes_to_keep that are not present in all healthy samples
    genes_for_median <- genes_to_keep[ gene_presence_in_healthy[genes_to_keep] < num_healthy ]
    
    # For each gene in genes_for_median, compute the median expression among healthy samples where measured
    median_expr <- sapply(genes_for_median, function(gene) {
      values <- sapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
        if (gene %in% rownames(mat)) {
          return(mat[gene, 1])  # assuming one column per healthy matrix
        } else {
          return(NA)
        }
      })
      median(values, na.rm = TRUE)
    })
    
    # Restrict patient matrix to genes_to_keep
    patient_mat_full <- patient_mat[genes_to_keep, , drop = FALSE]
    
    # Helper function: reformat a matrix to include exactly the genes in 'genes',
    # filling missing rows with the provided median (from median_expr)
    reformat_matrix <- function(mat, genes, medians) {
      new_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(genes), ncol = ncol(mat))
      rownames(new_mat) <- genes
      colnames(new_mat) <- colnames(mat)
      common_genes <- intersect(rownames(mat), genes)
      new_mat[common_genes, ] <- mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
      missing_genes <- setdiff(genes, common_genes)
      if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
        new_mat[missing_genes, ] <- matrix(medians[missing_genes],
                                            nrow = length(missing_genes),
                                            ncol = ncol(mat),
                                            byrow = FALSE)
      }
      return(new_mat)
    }
    
    # Reformat each healthy matrix using the helper function
    healthy_mats_full <- lapply(healthy_mats, function(mat) {
      reformat_matrix(mat, genes_to_keep, median_expr)
    })
    
    # Combine healthy matrices (columns) and then combine with patient matrix
    combined_mat <- do.call(cbind, healthy_mats_full)
    combined_mat <- cbind(patient_mat_full, combined_mat)
    
    gc()
  }
  
  #### 3. Create metadata (cData) for MAST ####
  # Get cell names for patient and healthy cells from the imputed matrices.
patient_cells <- colnames(patient_mat_full)
healthy_cells <- colnames(combined_mat)[!(colnames(combined_mat) %in% patient_cells)]

# Combine all cell names:
all_cells <- c(patient_cells, healthy_cells)
  
meta_data <- data.frame(
  wellKey = all_cells,  # explicitly add a wellKey column
  cell  = all_cells,
  group = factor(c(rep("Patient", length(patient_cells)),
                   rep("Healthy", length(healthy_cells)))),
  batch = sapply(all_cells, function(x) {
    tokens <- strsplit(x, "-")[[1]]
    tokens[1]
  }),
  sample = sapply(all_cells, function(x) {
    tokens <- strsplit(x, "-")[[1]]
    if(length(tokens) >= 2) tokens[2] else NA
  }),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
rownames(meta_data) <- meta_data$wellKey
  
  #### 4. Build the SingleCellAssay object for MAST ####
  # The SCT data are already normalized and log-transformed.
  sca <- FromMatrix(exprsArray = as.matrix(combined_mat),
                    cData      = meta_data,
                    fData      = data.frame(primerid = rownames(combined_mat),
                                             row.names = rownames(combined_mat)))
gc()  

  #### 5. Run the MAST model ####
  # Here we test for differential expression between Patient and Healthy cells.
  # The model formula includes the 'group' variable.
options(mc.cores = 100)

Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS="1",
           OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
           MKL_NUM_THREADS="1")

  if (unique(seu_patient$orig.ident) %in% trimws(unique(meta_data$batch[meta_data$group == "Healthy"])
)) {
    zlm_model <- zlm(~ batch + group,
                 sca = sca,
                 method = "bayesglm",
                 silent = TRUE,
                 ebayes = TRUE,
                 hook=NULL,
                 parallel = TRUE)
  } else {
    zlm_model <- zlm(~ group,
                 sca = sca,
                 method = "bayesglm",
                 silent = TRUE,
                 ebayes = TRUE,
                 hook=NULL,
                 parallel = TRUE)
  }


qsave(zlm_model,"/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/zlm_model_try_paralell.qs")

  # Perform likelihood ratio test for the coefficient corresponding to the Healthy group.
  # (The name "groupHealthy" assumes that the factor levels are Patient and Healthy.)
lrt <- lrTest(zlm_model, CoefficientHypothesis("groupPatient"))
  
  # qsave(lrt,"/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/lrt.qs")
  
  #### 6. Extract and format results ####
  summary_table <- summary(zlm_model, doLRT = "groupPatient")
  summary_dt    <- summary_table$datatable
  
    # Extract log fold changes (component "logFC") and p-values (component "H")
  fc_data <- summary_dt[contrast == "groupPatient" & component == "logFC", ]
  p_data  <- summary_dt[contrast == "groupPatient" & component == "H", ]
  
  # Merge results on the gene identifier ("primerid")
  de_results <- merge(fc_data, p_data, by = "primerid", suffixes = c("_fc", "_p"))
  
  # Rename the p-value column for clarity
  colnames(de_results)[colnames(de_results) == "Pr(>Chisq)_p"] <- "p_value"
  
  # Adjust p-values using FDR
  de_results$padj <- p.adjust(de_results$p_value, method = "fdr")
  
  return(de_results)
  

}
```

#THE whole autmated pipeline for most of the data:

Some data I did manually (see below). It's either becasue I've fo

```{r, "temp",eval=FALSE}
# Loop over each element in healthy_list


# for (i in seq_along(healthy_list)) {

for (i in length(healthy_list)) {

  # Get the current patient
  patient <- healthy_list[[i]]
  
  # Exclude the current patient from the healthy list to create current_healthy_list
  current_healthy_list <- healthy_list[-i]
  
  # Set condition to "pseudo_patient" for the current patient's Seurat object
  patient$seu$condition <- "pseudo_patient"
  
  # Run the differential expression analysis using get_limmatrend with threshold 0.75
  results <- get_edgeR_ZW(patient, current_healthy_list, 0.75)
  
  # Construct the path to save the results
  path_to_save <- paste0("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/null_hypotesis_tables/get_edgeR/",
                         patient$sample, "_", patient$dataset, "_pasudo_patient")
  
  # Save the results using qsave
  qsave(results, path_to_save)
  
  print(paste("finished with", patient$sample, patient$dataset, "as pasudo patient") )
}




```
